name: grok-subagent
description: Unofficial Codex plugin for local Grok Build external subagents via MCP and ACP, with durable background jobs and session control.

interface.shortDescription: Manage local Grok Build sessions from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Unofficial, experimental Codex plugin for local Grok Build external subagents on Windows. Use MCP to start, inspect, continue, interrupt and close background Grok ACP sessions, respond to permission requests and explicitly recover stale job state. Single-user local integration; not an OS sandbox. Local execution does not mean offline inference.
defaultPrompt: Use Grok to investigate an authorized task.
Check the progress of my Grok jobs.
Interrupt my Grok task and send a correction.
